context: Yuki and Naoko reflect on their friendship before Yuki leaves.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ゆきちゃん、来月、海外、出発、ね。
lines.en: Yuki-chan, you're leaving overseas next month.
lines.style: Warm opening, genuinely delighted for her. Soft, conversational tone—not rushed. A beat of reflection underneath, the kind an aunt gives when she's proud and will miss you.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、寂しい、けど、楽しみ。
lines.en: Yes—I'm sad, but I'm excited too.
lines.style: Honest and measured. A small lift on the 'excited' part, but the sadness is real underneath. Not trying to hide either feeling. Direct eye contact warmth.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 思い出、たくさん、出来た。
lines.en: We've made so many memories together.
lines.style: Soft realization, like she's taking it in as she says it. Not wistful—more grounded. A small pause before 'memories,' letting the weight land. Gentle gratitude threaded through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: You really are a precious friend to me.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. The word 'precious' lands with care—not overdone, but the feeling behind it unmissable. A slight tremor of real emotion at the end, caught and steadied.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 帰国の度、会いに、来てね。
lines.en: Come see me every time you come back home.
lines.style: Warm request, almost a promise wrapped in a request. Steady and sure—this is non-negotiable kindness. Slight lean forward in the delivery, like she's claiming this moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Firm commitment with no hesitation. Not breathless—solid. The kind of promise you make and keep. Voice steady, warm underneath the certainty.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Go out there and do your best.
lines.style: Encouraging send-off, tender underneath. Not a cheer—quieter than that. A small catch at the end, like she's holding her own emotion steady so Yuki can go forward light.
